title: Bootstrap ACP v0.3 control plane
objective: Establish resilient multi-agent execution with task graphs, budgets, checkpoints, provider-agnostic routing, swarm concurrency, evidence-first review, artifacts, memory and recursive learning.
acceptance: Task graph supports sequential and parallel execution
Context remains task-scoped and checkpoints are compact
Model routing and failover are configuration-driven
Concurrency is bounded globally and per model
Review findings feed a non-autonomous recursive learning loop
Artifacts and SQLite state are persisted locally
Design library has candidate/canonical governance and anti-slop rules
A local UI can expose task status and learning state
No secrets are persisted in task/checkpoint/artifact state
